notifications.name: KOHL ASMAR/ SURMA ASMAR
notifications.danger: The product contains lead (measured value up to 495.7 g/kg), an excessive concentration of cadmium (measured value up to 30.2 mg/kg), antimony (measured value up to 231 mg/kg), which is prohibited in cosmetic products, mercury (measured value up to 0.875 mg/kg) and an excessive concentration of arsenic (measured value up to 1.06 g/kg). Lead is harmful to human health, accumulates in the body and may affect breast-fed or unborn children. Cadmium is harmful to human health because it accumulates in the body, can damage the kidneys and bones and it may cause cancer. Antimony can irritate the skin. Mercury accumulates in the body and can damage the kidneys, brain and nervous system. Additionally, it may affect reproduction and the unborn child. Arsenic may cause cancer, may damage fertility or the unborn child, causes damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure. The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.

notifications.name: Vevor Jack with Airbag
notifications.danger: This product has no automatic brake and the handbrake mechanism can accidentally release if bumped or touched. If someone is working underneath a vehicle supported by this jack and inadvertently contacts the brake, the jack may suddenly release, causing the vehicle to drop and potentially crush a person beneath it. The air inlet and outlet are also connected through a common chamber, which could lead to the power flow being interrupted during use. This could also cause injuries to the user and other people next to it The product does not comply with the requirements of the Machinery Directive.

notifications.name: Proace and Proace City
notifications.danger: Vehicles equipped with diesel engines may experience fuel leakage from the common rail due to an out of specification roundness on the common rail cone. This may lead to poor sealing with the high-pressure pipe nut. As a result, fuel may leak between the nut and the common rail cone, creating fuel vapour and fuel flow towards the hot exhaust system. This can result in an under-hood fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
